profile.name: 低温制冷机监测系统
profile.description: 用于监测实验室低温制冷机或低温恒温器运行状态的仪器。它通常用于低温物理、量子器件和超导实验中，帮助研究人员查看制冷系统的当前状态与关键监测信息。
profile.description_en: An instrument used to monitor the operating status of a cryogenic refrigerator or cryostat in the laboratory. It is typically used in low-temperature physics, quantum-device, and superconducting experiments to let researchers check the current state and key monitored information of the cooling system.

registry.name: 稀释制冷机监控
registry.description: 稀释制冷机监控模块是由Oxford Instruments生产的深低温冰箱。支持Signal, Slot, get idn等操作。
